exposure: Women with preoperative State Anxiety Inventory scores >45
finding: While women with higher preoperative anxiety scores who underwent cesarean delivery with general anesthesia had higher pain intensity scores in the first 12 hours, there was no difference in postoperative analgesic requirements between the general and spinal anesthesia groups.
mod_finding: Women with preoperative state anxiety scores above 45 who had cesarean deliveries with general anesthesia reported higher pain intensity scores in the first 12 hours compared to those who received spinal anesthesia, but there was no difference in postoperative analgesic requirements between groups.
